mapper.insert: INSERT INTO agent_run (run_no, session_id, agent_id, user_id, trace_id, input_text, status, prompt_version, git_commit, started_at) VALUES (#{runNo}, #{sessionId}, #{agentId}, #{userId}, #{traceId}, #{inputText}, #{status}, #{promptVersion}, #{gitCommit}, NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE agent_run SET status = #{status}, output_text = COALESCE(#{outputText}, output_text), latency_ms = COALESCE(#{latencyMs}, latency_ms), error_msg = #{errorMsg}, ended_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
